name: Game-end rules
description: Generic conditions determining when a game ends and how its winner is resolved.

legal.disclaimer: Declarative content pack. It does not execute remote code.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: Standard game end
info.ability: Good wins when evil's main threat is gone; if the game declares no main threat, when no evil player remains. Evil wins when at most two regular players remain alive. If both conditions happen at once, good wins.

effects.reason: Se cumplieron las condiciones estándar de final de partida.
El Narrador fue ejecutado sin una regla activa que conceda la victoria al bien.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: Fast game end
info.ability: Good wins after eliminating evil's main threat, or all evil when no such figure exists. Evil wins when at most three regular players remain alive. If both conditions happen at once, good wins.

effects.reason: Se cumplió la política de final rápido.
El Narrador fue ejecutado sin una regla activa que conceda la victoria al bien.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: Extended game end
info.ability: Good wins after eliminating evil's main threat, or all evil when no such figure exists. Evil wins only when at most one regular player remains alive. If both conditions happen at once, good wins.

effects.reason: Se cumplió la política de final prolongado.
El Narrador fue ejecutado sin una regla activa que conceda la victoria al bien.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: Parity game end
info.ability: Good wins when no evil player remains. Evil wins when its living players equal or outnumber living good players. Neutrals do not count; if neither side has survivors, there is no winner.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: Elimination game end
info.ability: The only side, good or evil, with living players wins. Neutrals do not count; if neither side has survivors, there is no winner.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: Fall of the leaders
info.ability: The side that eliminates every opposing main figure wins. If a side declares no main figures, all of its players count. If both sides fall together, there is no winner.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: Last survivor
info.ability: When one regular player remains alive, that player earns a personal victory. If none remain, the game ends without a winner.
